items.abstract: <jats:p>In this paper, we study the singular factors of Thue-Morse word over an alphabet of size q. At first, we determine the ancestors of factors of word  Then, we describe explicitly the singular factors by using ancestors. At last, we characterize the bispecial factors of  by using the singular factors.</jats:p>
